effects.rationale: Hook trigger at 0.0 — vignette closes the frame on the teased payoff line. Talking-head footage, so the accent stays in the grade family: no glitch, no aberration, no blur on a face.
Second hook shot (0.9-2.0) — a 1.1x saturation lift separates the tease from the body; triggered by the hook moment, and a different type from the preceding hit.
5.8s into the 3.4s answer shot — subtle tonal settle keeps a low-motion two-shot from dying mid-phrase; gentle family chosen because motion is medium at most.
11.4s, the phase-1 contrast hold — 10% grain gives the longest early shot texture; triggered by the chapter-change into the hold at src 88.0.
18.3s emphasis beat — a 6% lift timed exactly to the punch-in snap on the line the chapter turns on; first brightness hit, phase 2 intensity step above hits 1-4.
21.9s, just after the whipPan chapter change at 21.5 — second vignette but wider feather, lower amount and different intensity so it is not a repeat of hit 1.
26.7s — an 8% cool shift marks the treatment change ahead of the phase-3 entry; triggered by the chapter change at 29.0 that the lightLeak transition carries.
29.0s phase-3 entry — lands on the whip-shake head; 1.16x is deliberately stronger than the 1.1x hook hit so saturation escalates across phases instead of repeating.
32.7s, final-chapter entry at src 341.2 — first contrast hit of the edit, opening the phase-3 run of stronger treatment; CSS multiplier 1.1, not a percent offset.
36.4s snap-zoom head — soft 12px bloom reads as optical highlight without blurring or splitting a face, the only punchy-family accent used on talking-head material.
CLIMAX 40.5s — lands inside the 0.75x slow window of the speed ramp (0.8-1.3s) so the strongest hit of the edit sits on the ramp peak; 1.14x escalates past the 1.1x hit at 32.7s.
42.0s across the landing hold — the tightest vignette of the edit (46%, hardest feather) closes the frame as the final phrase ends; third vignette, distinct params and intensity.
42.6s under the end card — shadows pulled 8% so the last shot settles rather than trails off; stronger than the 0.3-intensity tonal at 5.8s, closing the escalation curve.

21.5s chapter change (src 164.9 to 212.0) — whip matches the handheld energy of phase 2 and follows the motion direction of the tilt-up out of shot 9; no type repeats consecutively.

41.4s into the landing hold — the longest transition of the edit so the final 3.6s shot can breathe; not consecutive with the 15.0s crossfade.

captionTemplate.rationale: One template for the whole edit so type reads as a system: white Inter at y .76 — inside the 9:16 safe band (out of the top 10% and bottom 20%), below the face band of a two-shot podcast frame. Elements inherit it and override only for hierarchy (title/callout sizes, y .18-.20 for the two title cards).

motionMoments.rationale: Cold-open drop: the two hook shots (0-2.0s) clear picture-first, then the title card lands on the dipToBlack at 2.0 — triggered by the hook/payoff turn, and it is the edit's only title-card moment.
Climax cut at 40.0, co-timed with the speed-ramp acceleration peak, the whip-shake head and the 1.14x contrast hit — the single burst in the edit, placed where the structure already peaks.

metadata.rationale: Single 416.4s podcast source, no beat grid and no motion peaks in the analysis (b-roll tag, medium motion, conf .50), so the spine is built on chapter position across the runtime instead of beats: two cold-open flashes pulled from the late thirds (372.4, 246.1) hook in under 2s, then the edit walks the conversation forward through five chapter blocks (11s, 74s, 142s, 212s, 284s) and lands on the closing chapter (396.2) as a held shot. Phase 1 averages 2.5s per shot, phase 2 1.67s (67%), phase 3 1.5s with a 3.6s landing hold — density and hit intensity both escalate. Dialogue is the asset, so the treatment stays in the grade family (vignette, tonal, contrast, saturation, grain, glow) with no glitch/aberration/blur on faces, and the source audio is carried as a phase-coherent synced bed.
